walkthroughs.body_html:
Final Production — a core area of Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Final Production brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Final Production.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why can thermoplastics be recycled but thermosets cannot?
options: Thermosets are too dangerous to recycle.
Thinking about marketing the product.
Thermoplastics soften when heated and can be remoulded; thermosets have cross-links that lock the shape permanently.
Thermoplastics are cheaper, so it is worth recycling them.
